title: A key supplier is disrupted for three weeks
question: What if a key supplier is disrupted for three weeks?
note: The shop opens with about five weeks of stock, so a supplier problem only shows once reorders are due: the disruption starts on day 14 and the run is 60 days long.

arms.label: Kestrel Paper & Pen at a quarter capacity and 14 days slower, for 3 weeks
Every supplier late four times as often, for 3 weeks
